title: Tractatus super Psalmos / «Трактаты на Псалмы» Илария Пиктавийского
author: Hilary of Poitiers
size: Instructio + tractates on c. 58 Psalms (incl. 22 on Ps 118); est. 180–200k words
edition: Zingerle, CSEL 22 (1891), public domain; Doignon et al., CCSL 61 ff. (1997–)

value: The first major Latin Psalm commentary and a Latin adaptation of Origen. Key for Latin exegesis, the Nicene controversy and the Vetus Latina text. For Latinists and historians of exegesis.
